benefits.heading: The Best Free PDF Converter
benefits.intro: No matter what types of files you need to convert, our online file converter is more than just a PDF to Excel converter. It's the go-to solution for all of your document and file conversion needs.

items.title: Completely free
items.text: Our online PDF converter is completely free to use — no sign-up, no subscription, and no hidden fees. Convert files to and from PDF as often as you like and use our full suite of file conversion tools without ever creating an account.

items.title: Encrypted files
items.text: We care about the privacy of your data. 256-bit SSL encryption of all your files means that your files, documents, and data are secure during every upload and download. We also won't give or share any of your data with other parties.

items.title: Automatic deletion of your files
items.text: After you convert a document to PDF or to Excel, you'll be able to download and delete your files from our servers. If you happen to forget about deleting your files, they will be deleted from our server automatically after three hours to keep your information secure.

items.title: Universal conversion
items.text: Our free file converter works on any operating system, including Windows, Mac, and Linux. Because of this, you can convert PDF files to Excel from any OS, browser, or device — desktop, tablet, or phone — as long as you have an internet connection.

items.title: A suite of helpful file conversion tools
items.text: Our PDF file converter does much more than convert PDF to Excel. From compression and rotation to merging two PDFs and splitting one PDF into two, you can easily edit and manage your PDF files with our suite of online tools in the blink of an eye.
